title: NavigationLink2D with several layers in intersected regions
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]
v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Linux Mint 22 (Wilma) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600H (16 threads) - 15.31 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Link (mask = 1,2) between intersected regions (mask = 1 and mask = 2) inside that intersection. In some cases it cant find the path. I feel something to do with order in which the point (start) decides which layer it belogs to. I think it also has something to do with (0,0) relative coords(when start_position = (0,0). It seems like intersections == UB. I propose to specify layers for start and finish.

In cases when points are not located in the intersection zone all works normally.

### Steps to reproduce

Open archive as separatly project.

In  root script i wrote 2 normal cases and 2 strange cases, when agent cant find the path. You can move start point and end point i find some strange in pathfinding

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Test_NV.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31714245/Test_NV.zip)
